integrity: Structural derivation independently checked against finite two-design examples and Johnson graphs; independent mathematical validation not performed. No claim of formal certification.
limitations: Pure undirected flag adjacency and equality at quantifier rank three only; no arbitrary rank-four classification. Exact rank-four Johnson separation is shown, but not rank-four equivalence within the design family. The all-design result follows from a mathematical proof, not finite exhaustive enumeration. Historical priority beyond accessible material is unresolved.
title: Three rank-three theories of flag-adjacency graphs of finite Steiner \(2\)-designs
